cues.title: 先控制花粉来自哪里
cues.caption: 控制花粉，才能追溯亲本。
cues.zh: 同一朵花，可能接受自己的花粉，也可能接受外来花粉。如果不知道父本是谁，就难以解释后代。去掉未成熟的雄蕊，排除自身花粉；隔离袋限制外来花粉。再把指定父本的花粉送到保留的柱头，并重新隔离。关键不是记住步骤，而是让后代的来源可以追溯。
cues.en: The same flower can receive its own pollen or pollen from elsewhere. Unknown parentage makes offspring hard to interpret. Removing immature stamens excludes self pollen; a bag restricts foreign pollen. Apply the chosen parent’s pollen to the retained stigma, then isolate it again. These controls make parentage traceable.

cues.title: 第一代为什么都是高茎
cues.titleEn: Why are the first offspring tall?
cues.caption: 先看高茎，再检验因子是否保留。
cues.captionEn: Tall offspring do not reveal every factor.
cues.zh: 先看观察：纯种高茎与纯种矮茎杂交，子一代都是高茎，交换父母本也一样。矮茎因子消失了吗？颗粒假说认为，两方各提供一个因子，在后代重新成对。D显性，可以解释高茎，却还不能单凭第一代证明小写d仍在。下一步要看，自交后矮茎能不能重新出现。
cues.en: First, the observation: pure tall and short parents produce tall offspring, in either direction of the cross. Has the short factor vanished? The particulate hypothesis gives the offspring one factor from each parent. Dominance explains the tall plant, but the first generation alone cannot show that lowercase d remains. Selfing will test whether the short trait returns.

cues.title: 隐性性状重新出现
cues.caption: 矮茎再现；分离假说推出新的测交预测。
cues.captionEn: Segregation explains the return and predicts a new cross.
cues.zh: 固定记录里，矮茎重新出现：高茎七百八十七株，矮茎二百七十七株。现在用分离假说解释。杂合子产生配子时，D与小写d分开，每种各占一半。两方随机结合，有四种等可能的组合；其中两种都是杂合子。于是基因型预期一比二比一，表型预期三比一。再提出新预测：如果改与矮茎纯合子杂交，高茎与矮茎应各占一半。后面的测交实验会检验它。
cues.en: The fixed record shows short plants returning: seven hundred eighty-seven tall and two hundred seventy-seven short. Now apply segregation. The hybrid separates D and lowercase d into equally likely gametes. Random union gives four equally likely combinations; two are heterozygous. That predicts one to two to one for genotypes, and three to one for phenotypes. A new cross with a short homozygote should instead give equal tall and short offspring. The later test cross checks this prediction.

cues.title: 每次取球，都放回
cues.titleEn: Replace the balls after each draw
cues.caption: 模拟会波动；同一球放回原桶。
cues.captionEn: Samples fluctuate; each ball returns to its bucket.
cues.zh: 两个桶各放十个D球和十个小写d球。每次从各桶随机取一个，记录组合，再把同一个球放回原桶并充分混匀。看球返回原来的桶后，下一次才开始。三十次的小样本可能偏离一比二比一。增加样本有助于稳定频率，但不保证每次新增样本都会更接近理论值。
cues.en: Each bucket contains ten D balls and ten lowercase d balls. Draw one from each, record the pair, replace both in their own buckets and mix again. Thirty draws can depart from the one-to-two-to-one genotype expectation. Larger samples tend to stabilize frequencies, but each additional draw need not move them closer to theory.

cues.title: 用新实验检验解释
cues.titleEn: Test the explanation with a new cross
cues.caption: 测试亲本只给d，后代显露另一方的因子。
cues.captionEn: The tester supplies d; offspring reveal the other factor.
cues.zh: 让杂合子与矮茎纯合子杂交。隐性纯合子只提供小写d，所以后代直接显示杂合亲本提供了哪一种遗传因子。理论上高茎与矮茎各占一半。教材记录八十七株高茎和七十九株矮茎。这项新预测与实验相符，增加了对分离假说的支持。
cues.en: Cross the hybrid with a recessive homozygote, which provides only lowercase d. Offspring therefore reveal which factor came from the hybrid. Tall and short are each predicted at one half. The textbook records eighty-seven tall and seventy-nine short offspring, supporting the segregation hypothesis with a new prediction.

cues.title: 同时追踪两对性状
cues.caption: 两对因子分别保留，不混成一种。
cues.captionEn: Two factor pairs retain their identities.
cues.zh: 现在同时看种子颜色与形状。黄色圆粒纯种的每个配子都携带两种显性因子，绿色皱粒纯种的配子都携带相应的隐性因子，子一代都是双杂合子，表现黄色圆粒。图中黄色或绿色表示子叶颜色，光滑或皱缩表示种子形状。这里研究的是两对可以独立遗传的性状。
cues.en: Now track seed color and shape. Each gamete from the pure yellow-round parent carries both dominant factors. Each gamete from the pure green-wrinkled parent carries the corresponding recessive factors. Every first-generation offspring is a yellow-round double heterozygote. Color represents cotyledon color and contour represents seed shape. The model concerns independently assorting loci.

cues.title: 四种配子，十六种结合
cues.caption: 新组合引出独立分配，再提出新预测。
cues.captionEn: New combinations motivate an independent-assortment prediction.
cues.zh: 先看固定观察：绿色圆粒与黄色皱粒，是亲本没有的组合。自由组合假说提出，两对因子各自分离，组合成四种等概率配子。跟住一行和一列进入同一个交点：四乘四得到十六种受精组合。按颜色和形状归类，预期九比三比三比一；这是模型推导，不是重新生成实验记录。再换成只提供这两种隐性因子的测试亲本，四种后代表型应当等概率。接下来的测交会检验这个新预测。
cues.en: First, the fixed observation: green-round and yellow-wrinkled seeds combine traits differently from the parents. Independent assortment proposes four equally likely gametes. Follow one row and one column into their intersection. Four by four gives sixteen fertilization combinations, grouped into a nine-to-three-to-three-to-one expectation. That is a model prediction, not regenerated experimental data. With a tester supplying the recessive factor at each locus, the four offspring phenotypes should instead be equally likely. The next test cross checks that new prediction.

cues.title: 让四种配子显露出来
cues.caption: 固定测交记录，检验四种配子的预测。
cues.captionEn: Fixed test-cross records check the four-gamete prediction.
cues.zh: 把双杂合子与双隐性个体测交，测试亲本只提供这两种隐性因子。四种后代表型便直接对应双杂合子的四种配子，理论比例为一比一比一比一。教材分别记录了子一代作母本和作父本的结果，探索时可以切换。这个结论依赖独立遗传、等概率配子和相近存活率等条件，并不适用于任意两对基因。
cues.en: Cross the double heterozygote with a double-recessive tester, which supplies the recessive factor at each locus. The four offspring phenotypes reveal the four hybrid gamete classes, predicted equally. Exploration switches the textbook’s reciprocal datasets. This result assumes independent assortment, equal gamete probabilities and comparable viability; it does not apply to arbitrary pairs of genes.

translations.矮茎重新出现；不是因子被抹掉。: Short plants return; the factor was not erased.
translations.绿圆与黄皱：亲本没有的新组合。: Green round and yellow wrinkled are new combinations.
translations.检验新预测；不由模拟生成。: A test of the prediction, not simulated counts.
translations.颜色与形状，总要一起传吗？: Must color and shape travel together?
translations.追踪两方配子中的遗传因子: Trace the factors carried by both gametes
translations.每对取一个，再组合成配子: Take one factor from each pair to form a gamete
translations.每个配子只保留这一对中的一个。: Each gamete carries one factor of the pair.
translations.反例假设：只允许亲本组合YR和yr。: Counterexample: only parental YR and yr.
translations.由行列配子计算受精组合: Compute fertilization combinations from row and column gametes
translations.高茎与矮茎，应各占一半吗？: Should tall and short be equally likely?
translations.不控制来源，父本是谁？: Without controls, who is the father?
translations.让指定花粉的来源可追踪: Trace pollen from the chosen parent
translations.自身或外来花粉，会混淆来源。: Self or foreign pollen can confound parentage.
translations.同一个球取出后回到原桶: The same ball returns to its original bucket
translations.模型参数可变；教材记录保持原实验条件。: Model inputs change; records retain their original conditions.
translations.字母追踪可能传递的因子副本，不是减数分裂实拍。主模型假定配子等概率、随机受精与相: Letters trace hypothetical transmitted factor copies, not a filmed meiosis. The main model assumes equal gamete probabilities, random fertilization and comparable viability. The counterexample allows only YR and yr: a specified coupling phase without recombination, not Mendel’s observation.

question.zh: 矮茎为什么消失一代，又重新出现？
question.en: Why does the short trait disappear, then return?

lead.zh: 先固定花粉来源，再用真实高矮记录约束遗传因子假说。
lead.en: Control parentage, then constrain the factor hypothesis with fixed tall/short records.

principle.zh: 因子不融合；杂合子形成配子时分离，随机受精重新成对。
principle.en: Factors remain discrete, segregate into gametes and pair again at fertilization.

question.zh: 如果把杂合子改与矮茎纯合子杂交，预测还会是3∶1吗？
question.en: Would a hybrid crossed with a short homozygote still predict 3:1?

explanation.zh: 不会。测试亲本只提供d；杂合亲本D/d各半，预期高矮各半。P7测交再检验。
explanation.en: No. The tester supplies d, and the hybrid supplies D/d equally: equal phenotypes are predicted. P 7 checks the prediction.

question.zh: 为什么30次抽样不一定正好3∶1？
question.en: Why need 30 draws not be exactly 3:1?

lead.zh: 追踪取出并放回的同一球，区分随机频率与固定概率。
lead.en: Follow the same replaced ball and distinguish random frequency from probability.

principle.zh: 有放回保持每次的配子概率；有限独立样本会波动。
principle.en: Replacement preserves gamete probabilities; finite independent samples fluctuate.

question.zh: 样本增加一次，偏差一定缩小吗？
question.en: Must each extra draw reduce the deviation?

explanation.zh: 不一定。较大样本的频率通常更稳定，但单次新增结果可以增加偏差。
explanation.en: No. Larger-sample frequencies tend to stabilize, but a single additional result can increase the deviation.

question.zh: 怎样让看不见的配子组成显露出来？
question.en: How can offspring reveal unseen gamete classes?

lead.zh: 隐性测试亲本固定为d，让另一方的因子决定后代表型。
lead.en: A recessive tester fixes d so the other parent’s factor determines the offspring phenotype.

principle.zh: Dd×dd预测1∶1，教材87/79是独立固定记录。
principle.en: Dd×dd predicts 1:1; textbook 87/79 is a separate fixed record.

question.zh: 如果待测高茎亲本是DD，预测会怎样？
question.en: What if the tall parent under test is DD?

explanation.zh: DD只提供D，与dd杂交的后代全为Dd高茎；有限全高样本也不能绝对排除Dd。
explanation.en: DD supplies only D, giving all tall Dd offspring with dd. A finite all-tall sample does not absolutely exclude Dd.

question.zh: 黄色一定和圆粒一起遗传吗？
question.en: Must yellow and round be inherited together?

lead.zh: 用绿圆、黄皱的新组合约束假说，再从四种配子计算十六种结合。
lead.en: Use new green-round/yellow-wrinkled combinations to constrain the hypothesis, then compute sixteen unions from four gamete types.

principle.zh: 独立分配与随机受精推出9∶3∶3∶1，而不是把观察比例写进模拟。
principle.en: Independent assortment and random fertilization derive 9:3:3:1; the observed ratio is not an input to simulation.

question.zh: 若只允许YR与yr两种配子，还会有黄皱、绿圆吗？
question.en: If only YR and yr gametes were possible, would yellow-wrinkled or green-round offspring occur?

explanation.zh: 在指定YR/yr相位且无重组的反例里不会。它不能解释这些固定新组合；P11进一步检验四种配子。
explanation.en: Not in this specified YR/yr, no-recombination counterexample. It cannot explain those fixed new combinations; P 11 further tests four gamete classes.

question.zh: 双隐性测试亲本为什么能检验四种配子？
question.en: Why does a double-recessive tester reveal four gamete types?

lead.zh: 保持测试亲本只提供yr，对照预测与两组教材测交记录。
lead.en: Keep the tester supplying only yr, and compare the prediction with two fixed reciprocal textbook records.

principle.zh: 独立分配时四种配子各1/4，和yr结合后对应四种后代表型。
principle.en: Under independent assortment each gamete has probability 1/4; union with yr maps them to four offspring phenotypes.

question.zh: 交换父母本，会把固定记录改成完全相同的数吗？
question.en: Does swapping parental roles make the recorded counts exactly identical?

explanation.zh: 不会。主模型概率相同，教材两组实测样本不同；记录不由模型重算。
explanation.en: No. Model probabilities remain the same, while the textbook’s two samples differ. The model never recalculates their recorded counts.

topicSuggestion.description: 固定教材记录、遗传因子身份与独立概率计算，区分解释已有结果和预测新组合。
topicSuggestion.descriptionEn: Fixed textbook records and tracked factors separate explanations of existing results from predictions of new crosses.

scientificLimits: Factor chips are hypothetical transmitted copies, not Mendel observing genes or a literal meiosis movie.
Independent loci, equal gamete probabilities, random fertilization, complete dominance and comparable viability apply.
Parental-only is a counterfactual YR/yr coupling phase without recombination, not all linkage or the reported pea observation.
Fixed P11 male-tester record ends26; translated original corresponding experiment ends27. Preserve textbook and disclose discrepancy, do not silently overwrite.
P7 tall87/short79 is retained as textbook record; original paper presents these as stem-height marginals of a two-trait flower-color/stem-height experiment, not the same isolated table.
Finite all-dominant offspring cannot prove homozygosity with certainty.
Sampling is deterministic pseudorandom simulation with replacement, never a historical measurement.
